welcome_title: Carrying something you can’t quite say?
welcome_sub: KNOWN helps you find what feels close, meet someone in Scripture who carried something like it, and bring it to God in your own way.
welcome_private: No account. What you choose stays on this device.
mode_title: How are you using KNOWN right now?
mode_together_d: They’re with you in person or on a call.
guided_body: Keep your phone with you and make each choice yourself. The person beside you can help explain the rhythm, but you decide what to share.
guided_note: They can’t see anything you choose or write in KNOWN.
pics_sub: Choose one or two. There is no wrong answer.
story_source: In our words, from {ref}. The Scripture itself comes next.
nofit_sub: Not every story fits every moment. What would help?
nofit_words: Something for when words feel far away
note_label: If you want, add a few words
respond_title: What would you like to do next?
respond_sub: Choose one, try more than one, or stop here. Nothing is required.
r_pray_d: A short prayer you can use or change.
r_sit_d: Stay with the words. No task.
r_reflect_d: A few words, just for now.
r_share_d: You choose who, and what it says.
pray_sub: If these words fit, you can use them. Change anything, or simply be quiet with God.
pray_label: A prayer you can make your own
sit_sub: You don’t need to do anything. Read the words again if you want.
sit_breathe: Breathe slowly. You can stop anytime.
reflect_hint: This isn’t a journal. It’s kept only if you choose to keep it.
share_sub: You choose the person and the words. KNOWN never sends anything for you.
share_default: Hi, I just used KNOWN and something came up for me. I would appreciate having someone to talk to. You do not need to fix anything. Are you available to check in?
copied: Copied. Paste it into Viber, WhatsApp, Messenger or a text.
copy_fallback: Selected. Press and hold, or use Ctrl/Cmd + C, to copy.
share_note: Nothing is sent until you send it yourself.
keep_title: Would you like to keep anything?
keep_sub: Choose what you’d like to find in Moments. Nothing is kept unless you check it.
closing_sub: You can come back anytime, on your own or with someone you trust.
closing_saved: What you chose is waiting in Moments.
moments_sub: What you chose to keep, in one place.
moments_empty: When you keep something at the end of a moment, it appears here.
unfinished_note: Unfinished moments are removed after 3 days.
delete_q: Delete this moment? This can’t be undone.
moment_gone: This moment is no longer here.
translate_q: Would you like to switch this previous saved moment to your current app setting?
translate_done: Switched. Scripture now shows in {version}. Your own words stay exactly as you wrote them.
help_title: If you need help right now
help_sub: If you are in danger or thinking about hurting yourself, please reach out to someone now.
help_us: These services are for the United States.
help_911_d: If you are in immediate danger.
help_988_d: Call or text 988. Free, 24 hours a day. You can ask for an interpreter.
help_school_d: Most US colleges have a counseling or health center for students, including international students.
help_note: KNOWN is a place for prayer and reflection. It can’t respond in an emergency.
dark_note: Follows your device until you change it.
exit_sub: You can pause here. Nothing is shared.
exit_save_d: Pick up where you left off on this device, within 3 days.
paused_sub: Your step is saved on this device for 3 days. Open KNOWN again to continue.
recover_title: Would you like to continue your previous moment or start a new one?
recover_note: If you start a new one, the unfinished moment waits in Moments for 3 days.
save_fail: This browser isn’t letting KNOWN store things, so this is kept only until you close the page.
error_body: Let’s start again from the beginning. Your saved Moments are safe.
w_title: Bring what you’re carrying to God.
w_sub: For students far from home, carrying things that are hard to put into words.
w_private: No account. Nothing is saved unless you choose to save it.
or_words: or say it in your own words
words_ph: Write a sentence, in any language…
ai_note: To find a story, your words are sent to an AI service. KNOWN doesn’t store them unless you keep this moment.
thinking: Listening for a story that fits…
thinking_sub: This usually takes a few seconds.
ai_unsure: We weren’t sure which story fits. Choose a picture that feels closest.
ai_off: Finding a story from your own words isn’t available here. Choose a picture instead.
say_hint: Tap one to keep it with this moment.
ai_start: Here’s a place to start. If it doesn’t fit, there are others.
stays_hint: Choose what feels true. It goes with your prayer.
after_sub: Choose one thing, or simply finish.
a_keep_d: Choose what to save on this phone.
a_reach_d: Let a guide or friend know how you are.
reach_sub: You choose who and what it says. KNOWN never sends anything for you.
back_check: Check the meaning. In {lang}, this says:
tr_off: Translation isn’t available here. You can still copy your message.
tr_note: To translate, your message is sent to an AI service.
keep_msg_btn: Keep this message with my moment
keep_msg_done: Your message will be kept if you save this moment.
m_body: I used KNOWN today and read about {name} in {ref}. It helped me put into words what I’m carrying.
m_body2: I used KNOWN today and read {ref}. It helped me put into words what I’m carrying.
m_listen: Could you just listen for a bit this week?
m_time: Could we spend some time together this week?
help_world_d: Find a free, confidential helpline in your country at findahelpline.com.
help_local_d: If you are in immediate danger, call it now.
help_msg: I’m having a really hard time right now and I need someone to talk to. Can you call or message me?
crisis_title: You deserve help from a person right now.
crisis_body: What you wrote sounds like you may be in danger. Please reach out to someone who can be with you.
clear_q: Delete all Moments and settings on this phone? This can’t be undone.
recover_note2: If you start a new one, the paused moment is deleted.
removes_1: The paused moment is removed in 1 day.
removes_n: The paused moment is removed in {n} days.
pic_S: A figure sitting by a rainy window
pic_J: A figure dancing in warm sunlight
pic_F: A figure pressed against a wall in a dark hallway, holding a phone
pic_A: A figure standing with clenched fists over a crumpled letter
words_title: Say it in your own words
words_lead: Write a sentence about what you’re carrying. Any language is fine.
say_label: Which line is closest to you right now? Tap one to keep it with this moment.
lament_head: Or pray a psalm of lament
lang_fallback: This passage isn’t in your language in KNOWN yet, so it’s shown in English.
saved_ok: Saved to Moments on this phone.
